errors.text_span: Секторът, съответстващ на "Повше от 20%", е оцветен в лилаво и заема 33.3% от диаграмата
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the purple sector, corresponding to "More than 20%" ("Повече от 20%"), represents 33.3%. According to the figure, the purple sector is 9.5%. The value 33.3% corresponds to the blue sector ("0-5%"). Additionally, the category label is misspelled as "Повше" instead of "Повече".

errors.text_span: Секторът за "10-15%" е оцветен в червено и заема 14.3%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the "10-15%" category to the color red and the value 14.3%. In the figure, the "10-15%" category is orange and represents 23.8%. The red color and 14.3% value correspond to the "5-10%" category.

errors.text_span: този за "5-10%" е оцветен в оранжево и заема 23.8%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the "5-10%" category to the color orange and the value 23.8%. In the figure, the "5-10%" category is red and represents 14.3%. The orange color and 23.8% value correspond to the "10-15%" category.

errors.text_span: а секторът за "0-5%" е оцветен в синьо и заема 9.5%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the blue sector, representing the "0-5%" category, is 9.5%. The figure shows that the blue sector is 33.3%. The value 9.5% corresponds to the purple sector ("More than 20%").

errors.text_span: Някой от секторите не е визуално подчертан по-специално от останалите.
errors.evidence: The phrasing "Някой от секторите не е" is grammatically awkward in Bulgarian. A more correct phrasing would be "Нито един от секторите не е" (None of the sectors is).
